summary: @servicetitan/carto-charts-core preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: Package advertised as an ECharts theming layer ships a preinstall dropper. package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`; setup.mjs uses obfuscator.io-style identifier renaming (`_0x488df8` for fs, `_0x52943e` for https, junk indirection objects) to download a Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extract and chmod +x the Bun binary, then `execFileSync` it against a bundled 727KB heavily obfuscated file `math_init.js` at the tarball root. `math_init.js` is a compiled `@bun @bun-cjs` bundle with string-array rotation (`WV8StW` shift function), a 1000+-entry constant table, and a mixed-alphabet decoder (`hc1jfK9`) — opaque contents unrelated to chart theming. Execution via an alien runtime (Bun) bypasses Node-based static analysis of the payload. The cover-story filename `math_init.js`, the obfuscated wrapper, and the runtime mismatch with the package's declared purpose indicate an alternate-runtime dropper delivering attacker-controlled code on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
